title: Won't Somebody Please Think of The Traders??
summary: Finance commentary on a bank's repeated failure to catch unauthorized options trades on a hedging desk; tangential to retail get-rich schemes.

assertions.quote: His point that it took months to discover these allegedly unauthorized trades does raise questions about how good the risk systems are

verdicts.note: Repeated rogue-trader cases at major banks show controls catching unauthorized positions late.

assertions.quote: risk limits don’t just apply to position sizes, they also apply to which financial instruments a trader is authorized to trade

verdicts.note: Standard bank mandate structure; instrument restrictions are part of every desk's limits.

assertions.quote: a lot of your bonus compensation is withheld and can be clawed back if you make any big losses

verdicts.note: Deferred bonus and clawback rules have been standard at large banks since the 2008 reforms.

assertions.quote: something about its technicality, about the discipline of making money by buying and selling almost-but-not-quite identical things, that might give people ideas

verdicts.note: An anecdotal pattern across a few rogue-trader cases, not an established finding.
